component.name: Muybridge
component.summary: Take still frames out of video

description.p: Muybridge pulls still images out of a video at whatever rate you ask for — ten a second, one every few seconds, or anything in between. Point it at a file, say how often to sample, and it writes a numbered sequence of PNG or JPEG frames into the folder you choose.

ul.li: Trim to a range, so only the part you care about is sampled
Show the video's size, codec, frame rate and length before you start
Estimate how many frames a job will write, before it writes any
Report live progress, and stop cleanly when you cancel
Name the sequence, choose the counter width, and add a suffix

description.p: ffmpeg does the work and is bundled with the app, so there is nothing to install alongside it. Files are reached through the desktop portals: the app sees the video you picked and the folder you chose, and nothing else.
